comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: PHASE-2A DESIGN ACT — the crate-level module map (draft, for operator adoption). All in the vsdd binary crate per the architecture sketch: vsdd/src/status/mod.rs — the composition root and effectful shell: ONE acquisition, ONE derivation, ONE rendering per invocation; composes the broken-state outputs on all three surfaces when the state read fails; hosts the instrument seams. vsdd/src/status/segment.rs — the PURE segment renderer: (answer-or-broken, display fields, the loaded statusline data) to one line; field order repo-name/phase-answer/work-item/milestone-with-count; per-field width budgets with the (cut) mark set off by a space and the milestone name truncating before the count; worded absences from the data; the degraded marker as the kind's plain marker word; no session field; deterministic byte-for-byte; color as optional decoration only. vsdd/src/status/human.rs — the PURE human form: TWO SECTIONS per the adopted facets note — the answer (position: phase, layer, next action, composition) and the report (health: degraded kind with its full next-step text, integrity findings, substrate findings); superset of every segment field plus the session rendering (the demotion ruling); broken-state renders the rustc-shaped diagnostic with per-kind recovery, its grammar aligned to mdatron's exact rendering shape (the boundary-sweep disposition, executed here). vsdd/src/status/machine.rs — the PURE machine form: named blocks answer and report; broken-state is the structured state-unreadable signal (enumerated kind, diagnostic payload, recovery action from the vocabulary); superset-of-segment verified. vsdd/src/status/broken.rs — the shared broken-state composition, carrying #740: the last-boundary truth (the most recent boundary commit's subject from a bounded git log query — a new pub seam in vsdd-core's shell since the runner is core-internal) rendered as recovery context on the human and machine forms; absence of a boundary commit is a worded absence, never a failure. vsdd/src/status/instruments.rs — the conduct seams: the counting stdin wrapper (the statusline path reads zero bytes; the sentinel fixture backs the count), the acquisition counter, the whole-invocation wall-clock against the 250ms budget with the 7-run median and twice-budget ceiling; model-absence is the test environment's property (no credentials, no network), documented not coded. vsdd/src/status/multi.rs — the composed multi-repo display over the explicit repo-set config ({repos, per_repo_budget_ms} at the registered location): one segment line per repo, current first, per-line worded repo identity, every single-segment conduct check holding per line. templates/statusline/vsdd-statusline.sh — the wiring script (installed by Layer 4, authored here): reads the repo-set config, invokes the composed display, passes the substrate's stdin through unconsumed, aggregate cost denominated repo-count-times-per-repo-budget; ownership and drift refusal per the managed-file discipline; the non-wrapper composition instruction ships beside it per the registered conduct.
